title: View and record the patient's odontogram
summary: Open the odontogram from the appointment to see the status of each tooth and mark what was done.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Odontogram
steps.details: Tap the tooth surface, then the condition in the inspector; “Record as” sets whether it is indicated, existing or done today. What you dictate to the agent shows up as a proposal until you confirm it, and everything goes into this appointment's odontogram session.
